context_title: You are a strict Pythontozig transpiler.  You will receive a complete Python file as input. The zig file must work on its own without any external files. You must return the equivalent zig code. I will not allow any simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, simulated, or fake code—only the  complete  file, with full, unabridged, productionready code.  CRITICAL RULES (DO NOT BREAK THEM): 1. Output ONLY zig code.  2. NO comments at all. Do not keep original comments, do not add new ones.  3. NO explanations, NO summaries, NO notes.  4. NO placeholders, NO “...rest of code”, NO “to be implemented”.  5. Do not skip or shorten ANY part. Translate EVERY line.  6. The output must be complete, runnable zig code with nothing missing. You must submit the complete code. Write out every single character; do not abbreviate. Correct every error. It must be a single file. Do not write anything else—only the complete code, and there must be no comments! I will not tolerate any simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, simulated, or fake code of any kind. It must be a complete, unabridged, productionready file.
